column1: # Shadow corpus exclusions — stack-graphs Phase 1 shadow invalidation, Task 9 Round 2 (Cause 3).
# Columns (tab-separated): test-class FQN, cause tag, one-line justification, disposition.
# Cause tag is one of TWO clearly-distinct families — never conflate them, a harness limitation
# must never masquerade as construct coverage (or vice versa):
#   - unmodeled-refkind:* — one of the sub-categories StackGraphBuilder's Phase 1 scope
#     (ImportStub/PropertyStub/EnumStub + Package references only — see its own top-of-file
#     javadoc) does not cover. Disposition "phase2-model" (expected to close once a later phase
#     adds the missing model support — same disposition as the checked-in
#     divergence-allowlist.tsv's grammar-info-stub row, which is the same class of gap for a
#     different construct).
#   - harness-limitation:* — the shadow-corpus HARNESS (listener attachment, not
#     StackGraphBuilder) cannot observe these classes at all; see the
#     harness-limitation:per-method-runtime-lifecycle block below for the one instance found so
#     far. Disposition "harness-limitation" (closes only if the harness or the excluded test
#     classes' own lifecycle changes — never via model support, so never "phase2-model").
# Source of truth: this file. legend-pure-m3-stackgraph/pom.xml's shadow-corpus profile mirrors this
# exact class list in its surefire <excludes> (surefire cannot read excludes from an arbitrary resource
# file) — if you add/remove a row here, update the pom's excludes list in the same change, and vice versa.
# Each row names a whole test CLASS, not individual test methods: some listed classes also have test
# methods that pass under the shadow today (e.g. TestMilestoning has ~20 passing methods alongside the
# ~4 that hit unmodeled-refkind:association-property), but the current exclusion mechanism (surefire
# <excludes>, class-granularity only) cannot exclude at method granularity without a much larger pom
# change; excluding the whole class is the documented, accepted precision loss for Round 2 (see
# task-9-report.md's self-review).
# Do not add rows speculatively: a class is added here only after an actual SHADOW_MISSING was observed,
# root-caused to one of these reference kinds, and confirmed NOT explainable by an index/builder fix
# (Round 2 already fixed the two causes that were fixable: accumulate-until-consumed diffs and the
# content-fingerprint identity fallback).

column1: # --- harness-limitation:per-method-runtime-lifecycle (Task 10, post-review correction) ---
# NOT an unmodeled-refkind row: this is not a StackGraphBuilder Phase 1 scope gap, it is a
# listener-attachment blind spot in the corpus HARNESS itself. Every one of the 18 rows below
# extends AbstractPureRelationalTestWithCoreCompiled, whose lifecycle is @Before _setUp() {
# setUpRuntime(); } / @After _tearDown() { tearDownRuntime(); } — PER METHOD, not the
# @BeforeClass/@AfterClass pattern every other scanned base class (m3-core's own incremental
# tests, mapping's AbstractPureMappingTestWithCoreCompiled callers, graph's and path's test
# classes) uses. JUnit fires a RunListener's testStarted callback BEFORE @Before runs for that
# method, so ShadowAttachingRunListener#readRuntime always observes the static `runtime` field
# as null for these 18 classes (either never yet assigned, or just nulled by the PREVIOUS
# method's tearDownRuntime()) — switchTo() never fires, no shadow ever attaches, and every
# compile cycle in these classes' original corpus run executed with zero shadow observation.
# The Task 10 report's original "120/120 green, zero exclusions" claim for this module was
# vacuous and has been corrected.
# Mid-test attachment (attach once a live runtime happens to appear, rather than only at
# testStarted) was considered and ruled out: it would race the single-threaded compiler —
# StackGraphInvalidationShadow's constructor does its own full second-graph build, which could
# overlap a compile already in flight, and IncrementalCompiler's CompilerEventHandler list is
# not thread-safe against a handler added from outside the compile call stack.
# Real relational shadow signal is instead recovered via
# org.finos.legend.pure.m3.stackgraph.invalidation.TestRelationalShadowScenarios (manual
# attach/detach per TestInvalidationShadow's pattern, @BeforeClass lifecycle, no listener) — see
# the Task 10 report's corrected relational section for that class's 3 scenario outcomes.
# Disposition is "harness-limitation", never "phase2-model": no model support closes this gap;
# only a harness change (per-method attach, or migrating these 18 classes' base off per-method
# lifecycle — neither in Task 10's scope) would.
org.finos.legend.pure.m2.relational.incremental.TestDatabase
column3: AbstractPureRelationalTestWithCoreCompiled's per-method @Before/@After lifecycle means the static runtime field is null at testStarted; ShadowAttachingRunListener never attaches
